items.title: Nothing Offers a Full Look at Ear (note) AI Earbuds and Recording Case
items.summary: Nothing has revealed detailed images of its Ear (note) earbuds, whose microphone-equipped charging case can record, transcribe and summarize conversations. The buds record phone calls and are due to launch on December 8, with support for AI agents and voice control.

items.title: Noise Master Buds Open Review: Clipped On, Tuned In
items.summary: The Hindu BusinessLine finds Noise's clip-on open-ear earbuds comfortable and stylish, with balanced Bose-tuned sound and roughly six hours of battery life per charge. The reviewer sees them as a strong value entry point for first-time open-ear buyers.

items.title: Xiaomi Says Its TWS Earbuds Shipments Ranked Second Globally in Q3 2026
items.summary: Xiaomi's third-quarter 2026 results cite Omdia data showing its true wireless stereo earbuds ranked second in shipments both worldwide and in mainland China. The company also reported 27.2 billion yuan of IoT and lifestyle product revenue for the quarter.

items.title: Cleer Bridge Open-Ear Clip-On Earbuds Launch with Dolby Audio and aptX Lossless
items.summary: Cleer Audio has launched Cleer Bridge, a $159.99 clip-on open-ear earbud with a 12mm titanium driver, Dolby Audio, Snapdragon Sound and Hi-Res Wireless certification. The model won a 2026 Red Dot Best of the Best design award and offers up to 23 hours of playback with its case.

items.title: Audio-Technica Launches ATH-TWX9MK3 True Wireless Earbuds in Japan
items.summary: Audio-Technica's new flagship ATH-TWX9MK3 went on sale in Japan on November 20 at about 41,800 yen, bringing Bluetooth 6.0, LHDC-V5 at up to 24-bit/192kHz and fit-adaptive noise cancellation. The model replaces the MK2 with a revised beryllium-coated driver and rates 11 hours of ANC playback.

items.title: TechRadar Pits Five of 2026's Best Wireless Earbuds Against Each Other for Black Friday
items.summary: TechRadar's group test compares Apple AirPods 5, Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (Gen 2), Technics EAH-AZ100, Nothing Ear (a) and Shokz OpenFit Pro on sound, ANC, stamina and features. Technics EAH-AZ100 takes the overall crown and best sound, while Shokz OpenFit Pro wins on stamina.

items.title: Xiaomi Clip Open-Ear Earbuds Arrive in Europe at 149.99 Euros
items.summary: Xiaomi has launched its first clip-on open-ear earbuds in Europe, with 11mm drivers, Bluetooth 5.4, LHDC 5.0 and Apple Find My support. Notebookcheck notes the advertised 38-hour battery life falls to 25 hours with LHDC enabled and that the codec requires Android 17 or later.

items.title: SOUNDPEATS Air6 Pro Launches in Australia with 58dB Adaptive ANC
items.summary: SOUNDPEATS has launched the Air6 Pro true wireless earbuds in Australia at A$113.99, with an 11mm driver, Bluetooth 6.0, adaptive ANC rated at up to 58dB and about 52 hours of total playback. The model shifts the Air Series tuning toward natural vocals and instrument separation, with LDAC and aptX Lossless support.

items.title: Noble Audio Astrid Debuts With Hybrid Drivers, LDAC and Personalized Sound
items.summary: Noble Audio has released the Astrid true wireless earbuds at $539, pairing an 8.3mm dynamic driver, a 6mm planar driver and a balanced armature in each earbud. The model adds Audiodo Personal Sound, adjustable EQ, Bluetooth 6.0, LDAC and aptX Adaptive, with up to 40 hours of playback including the case.

items.title: SoundGuys Updates Its Best Wireless Earbuds Guide for Late 2026
items.summary: SoundGuys has refreshed its lab-tested buying guide with six main picks, naming the Sony WF-1000XM6 as best overall and Apple AirPods Pro 3 as the top choice for iPhone users. The November 3 update adds the JBL Tour Pro 3 as the best-sounding option and revises the sections on custom EQ and what to look for.
